scene_summary: Two unequal chains of sharply folded, textured magenta planes float on black. The dominant chain rises from a cropped lower-left foreground through broad emerald bevels, orange-yellow insets, triangular cutouts, and progressively smaller facets. A detached upper-right curl repeats this vocabulary at a smaller scale. Visible colored faces support interaction mapping; there are no visible labels or players.
